Something painful happens to everyone. Suffering is a different matter.

Kevin Trudeau quotes the Buddha: pain in life is inevitable, but suffering is optional. He says we should feel the full range of emotions, because that is part of being alive.

The difference, he says, is whether you are lost inside the pain or watching yourself go through it.

How do you handle it when life hurts?
